sentences.en: Rocks and minerals are useful for us in many ways.
sentences.zh: 岩石和矿物在很多方面对我们都有用。

sentences.en: I always carry a bottle of mineral water with me.
sentences.zh: 我总是随身携带一瓶矿泉水。

sentences.en: Paracelsus pioneered the use of chemicals and minerals in medicine.
sentences.zh: 帕拉塞尔苏斯开创了将化学物质和矿物质用于医学的先河。
